clips.title: The story
paras: Crown Guard Tower is a ruined Lordaeron scout tower in the southern Eastern Plaguelands. The Scourge destroyed it during the invasion of Lordaeron in the Third War, and its broken stones have stood amid the blight ever since.

Once part of the Kingdom of Lordaeron's defenses, Crown Guard Tower was a scout tower watching over the lands of eastern Lordaeron. When the Scourge overran the kingdom, the tower was destroyed and left in ruins, one of several fallen towers scattered across what are now the Eastern Plaguelands. Its charred stones stand in a land the undead still hold.
